description:
Update a chat conversation

Changes the status, the archive flag or the assigned human agent of a chat conversation. Chat threads only: an id belonging to a voice call is rejected with 400, and a body with no updatable field is rejected with 400 as well. Assigning an agent also stamps the assignment time and, unless the same request sets a status, moves the thread to `active`, mirroring what the dashboard does. Setting the status to `closed` runs the same finalisation as the close endpoint, recomputing the conversation analytics. The updated conversation is returned in `data`.

body.description: The fields to change. `status` moves the thread between `waiting`, `active` and `closed`, `isArchived` moves it in and out of the inbox, and `assignedAgentId` names the human agent to hand it to, or null to unassign. At least one field must be present.

assignedAgentId.description: Live chat agent to assign, or null to unassign.
